title: The Tree of Knowledge
description: The tree that was good for food, pleasant to the eyes, and desired to make one wise.

title: The Serpent's Question
description: "Yea, hath God said?" — the first doubt cast on God's word.

title: Eyes Opened
description: They knew they were naked, and sewed fig leaves together to cover their shame.

title: Coats of Skins
description: Even in judgment, the Lord God clothed Adam and his wife with His own hand.

title: The Flaming Sword
description: Cherubim and a sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

title: Sent Forth From Eden
description: To till the ground from whence he was taken — the beginning of man's long road home.
